title: 2 Litre Hand Pressure Sprayer: Small Jobs, Garden and Home in Kenya
description: When a 2 litre hand pressure sprayer makes sense, what you can spray with it, and how to fill, pump and rinse it so the nozzle keeps working.
answer: A 2 litre hand pressure sprayer suits small jobs: kitchen gardens, flower beds, nurseries and household pest control. The clear tank is marked from 500 ml to 1750 ml, so you mix only what the job needs. Fill to the top mark only, pump until you feel resistance, and rinse the nozzle after every use.
intro: Not every spraying job needs a 20 litre knapsack on your back. For a flower bed, a nursery corner or a spot treatment, a small tank is easier to carry and wastes less mixed product. The [[/p/2-litre-hand-pressure-sprayer-2-litres.html|2 Litre Hand Pressure Sprayer]] is a Made-in-Kenya hand pump sprayer sold as one piece, with a clear tank, a steel pump rod and an adjustable brass nozzle.

sections.heading: What can you spray with a 2 litre sprayer?
paragraphs: The catalog lists garden pests, foliar feeds, disinfectants and household pest control products. Each one is used as its own label directs, so the sprayer is only the tool.
Its small size suits kitchen gardens, flower beds, nurseries, greenhouse corners, small poultry or livestock houses and spot treatments where a large knapsack sprayer would be too much.

sections.heading: How do you fill and pump it?
paragraphs: Fill the tank to the level you need, using the marks on the side, and add your product as its label directs. Do not fill above the top mark, because the tank needs air space to build pressure.
Close the cap firmly, pump the handle until you feel resistance, then spray evenly and keep moving so every surface is covered. Pump again when the spray weakens.
bullets: Read the label of the product and mix only the volume you need
Check that the cap closes firmly and the nozzle is clear
Use a separate sprayer for herbicides where possible

sections.heading: How do you keep it working?
paragraphs: Rinse the tank and nozzle with clean water after every use so residue does not block the nozzle, then store the sprayer clean and dry, out of direct sun.
Wear gloves, a mask and eye protection when spraying chemicals, and release the pressure before you open the cap.
Never eat, drink or smoke while spraying, and keep the sprayer and any chemical away from children.

title: Generic 7L Electric ULV Fogger: What It Does and What to Check
description: What an electric ULV fogger is, the uses listed in the catalog, and what to confirm on the product label and manual before you fill the tank.
answer: The Generic 7L Electric ULV Portable Fogger Sprayer Machine is a portable electric fogger sold as one unit. ULV means ultra-low volume: it applies a small amount of liquid as a fine mist. It is the equipment, not the chemical, so choose a product whose label allows fogging or ULV use and follow its dilution.
intro: Some pests hide in corners and crevices that a hand sprayer reaches slowly. A fogger spreads a fine mist through a room instead. The [[/p/generic-7l-electric-ulv-portable-fogger-sprayer-machine-1-unit.html|Generic 7L Electric ULV Portable Fogger Sprayer Machine]] is meant for farmers, homeowners and businesses who want a portable spraying solution for ULV work such as mosquito control, crop protection and indoor fogging.

sections.heading: What does ULV mean?
paragraphs: ULV stands for ultra-low volume. A ULV machine applies a small amount of liquid as a fine mist, which is why this kind of equipment is used for rooms, corners and crop areas.
The machine is the equipment, not the chemical. You pair it with a product whose label allows ULV or fogging use, and you follow that label for the amount to use.

sections.heading: What should you check before the first use?
paragraphs: The catalog does not give the power supply, output or settings, so follow the manufacturer's manual for filling, start-up and shut-down.
Read the label of the product you plan to use and confirm that it may be used in a fogger or ULV machine. Then follow its dilution and the time the space must stay closed.
bullets: Read the machine manual and the product label before the first use
Remove people, pets, food, feed and animals from the space you will fog
Keep the electrical parts dry and away from spilled liquid

sections.heading: How do you use it safely?
paragraphs: Electric equipment and liquid do not mix, so do not use the machine if a part is damaged, and switch it off before you refill or clean it.
Wear the protective equipment named on the product label, including a respirator if the label requires one. Do not enter a fogged space until the label says it is safe.
Keep the machine and any chemical away from children, pets, food and water sources.

sections.heading: What does the catalog not tell you?
paragraphs: The catalog does not list the power supply, tank material, output or droplet size, so check the manufacturer's manual for those.

faq: What is the Generic 7L Electric ULV Portable Fogger used for?
It is a portable electric ULV fogger sprayer for pest control, with mosquito control, crop protection and indoor fogging listed as uses.

ULV stands for ultra-low volume. It means the machine applies a small volume of liquid as a fine mist.

The catalog does not name one. Choose a product whose label allows ULV or fogging use, and follow its dilution.

title: Jacto HD 550 Knapsack Sprayer: Piston Pump and Agitator Explained
description: What the piston pump, internal agitator and reinforced hose of the Jacto HD 550 20 litre knapsack sprayer do, and how to care for it.
answer: The Jacto HD 550 is a heavy-duty manual knapsack sprayer with a 20 litre tank. The piston pump builds pressure with each stroke of the lever, and the internal agitator stirs the mixture as you pump. It sprays pesticides, herbicides and foliar fertilizers on farms and gardens, and is used for pest control.
intro: A sprayer is one of the most used tools on a farm, and a weak one wastes product and time. The [[/p/jacto-hd-550-knapsack-sprayer-20-litres.html|Jacto HD 550 Knapsack Sprayer]] is designed for repeated, regular use by commercial growers, farm workers, spraying contractors and home gardeners.

sections.heading: What does each part do?
paragraphs: A strong, well-built sprayer gives more even coverage, lasts through many seasons and wastes less product.
bullets: Piston pump: builds pressure with each stroke of the lever, which gives a steady spray
Internal agitator: stirs the mixture as you pump, which helps keep products that settle, such as suspensions and powders, evenly mixed
Reinforced hose: made to take pressure and daily handling
Adjustable nozzle: changes the spray pattern from fine coverage on leaves to a more directed spray

sections.heading: How do you use it?
paragraphs: Fill the tank to the level you need, add the product at the rate on its label, close the lid and pump to build pressure. Spray evenly and walk at a steady pace.
Calibrate your sprayer so that you know how much it delivers over a given area, and use that figure to work out how much product goes into each tank.
It sprays pesticides, herbicides and foliar fertilizers on crops, orchards, flower farms and gardens, and it is used for pest control around homes, stores and compounds.

sections.heading: What should you check before you spray?
paragraphs: Follow the product label for every chemical you mix.
bullets: Check the seals and the hose for leaks
Clean the nozzle and the filter
Where possible, use a separate sprayer for herbicides to avoid contamination

sections.heading: How do you stay safe and look after it?
paragraphs: Wear gloves, a mask, goggles and protective clothing when spraying, and follow the product label. Do not spray in windy weather.
Do not eat, drink or smoke while spraying. Release the pressure before opening the lid, and keep the sprayer away from children.
After every use, rinse the tank, hose and nozzle with clean water, clean the nozzle and filter regularly, and store the sprayer clean and dry, away from direct sun.

faq: Is the Jacto HD 550 manual or motorised?
It is a manual knapsack sprayer with a piston pump, so you pump it by hand with the lever.
What does the internal agitator do?
It stirs the mixture inside the tank as you pump, which helps keep products that settle, such as suspensions and powders, evenly mixed.
Can I use it for herbicides and pesticides?
Yes. It is made for pesticides, herbicides and foliar fertilizers. Where possible, keep a separate sprayer for herbicides to avoid contamination.

title: Greenberg Bronze 16 Litre Knapsack Sprayer: Nozzle and Strainer
description: How the adjustable nozzle, strainer basket and back-contoured 16 litre tank of the Greenberg Bronze knapsack sprayer work, and how to maintain it.
answer: The Greenberg Bronze is a heavy-duty manual knapsack sprayer with a 16 litre tank, made for agrochemicals, foliar fertilizers and public health control products. Its adjustable nozzle switches between a concentrated jet and a broad cone, and the strainer basket in the wide filling mouth helps prevent nozzle clogging.
intro: A sprayer that leaks, clogs or tires your back costs you time and wastes chemical. The [[/p/greenberg-bronze-knapsack-sprayer.html|Greenberg Bronze Knapsack Sprayer]] is a 16 litre manual sprayer built from rugged, high-grade plastic to cope with daily agricultural use, and it is sold as 1 sprayer.

sections.heading: What are its main features?
paragraphs: The product page lists these features.
bullets: 16 litre tank for fewer refill trips
Ergonomic tank shape that sits naturally against the operator's back
Robust pumping mechanism that gives consistent operating pressure
Even, fine spray mist that reaches upper and lower leaf surfaces
Adjustable nozzles: a concentrated jet or a broad cone pattern
Wide filling mouth with a built-in strainer basket
Accessible seals and durable shut-off valves for simple maintenance

sections.heading: What jobs is it for?
paragraphs: Use it for crop protection sprays, foliar feeding, weed control and pest control jobs on small and medium farms, kitchen gardens, greenhouses and nurseries.
The adjustable nozzle lets you use a tight jet to reach a target and a wider cone for covering foliage, so one sprayer handles several tasks.
Even coverage is what makes a product work properly, because missed patches become the place where pests and weeds return.

sections.heading: How do you fill and use it?
paragraphs: Fill through the wide filling mouth, where the strainer basket helps prevent nozzle clogging, and add the product as its label directs. Close the tank and pump to a steady pressure.
Switch between the jet and the cone with the adjustable nozzle, depending on whether you are aiming at a target or covering foliage, and keep a regular pace so every row is covered evenly.

sections.heading: How do you stay safe and look after it?
paragraphs: Always wear overalls, boots, gloves and a face mask when spraying agricultural chemicals, and follow the chemical label for dose and re-entry times. Keep the sprayer and all chemicals out of reach of children.

After every use, rinse the tank with clean water, then spray clean water through the hose and nozzle so no residue dries inside. Store the sprayer upside down in a shaded, dry place, away from direct sunlight and extreme temperatures.
If you can, keep one sprayer for herbicides and another for insecticides and fungicides, so herbicide residue never reaches your crop.

Yes. It is designed for agrochemicals, foliar fertilizers and public health control products. Rinse well between products.
